description_for_human: Read-only access to your PeopleOS team data.
description_for_model: Read-only lookup of the user's PeopleOS records: direct reports (listPeople, getPerson), 1:1/interview notes (listInterviews), follow-up action items (listFollowUps), accomplishments (listAccomplishments) and freeform notes (listNotes). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; months are YYYY-MM. Use the person parameter with a name fragment when the id is unknown.

functions.name: listPeople
functions.description: List direct reports, optionally filtered by status or text.

functions.name: getPerson
functions.description: One person with recent interviews, open follow-ups and accomplishments.

functions.name: listInterviews
functions.description: Search 1:1s and interviews by person, type, date range or text.

functions.name: listFollowUps
functions.description: List follow-ups (default: open), soonest due first.

functions.name: listAccomplishments
functions.description: List accomplishments by month, date range, person or team.
